about: Per-home-club watch links for the National League Cup LIVE embed (embeds/nl-cup-live.html). Keyed by the club name exactly as the NLS API returns it, because that is the join key the widget already has in hand. One URL per HOST club: every cup tie is played at a member club's ground, and a club's stream page does not change from round to round, so the same link serves every game that club hosts all season. An empty string means 'no link yet' — that tile still renders, it just is not clickable. Add a club here the season it enters the cup; entrants per season live in competitions-meta.json.
urlsAbout: www, never beta. A beta.thenationalleague.org.uk URL sends fans to a staging host they cannot be expected to trust or reach; the stream ids are the same on both, so only the host differs. tests/nl-cup-live.test.mjs fails on any link that is not https://www.thenationalleague.org.uk/. Note the widget arms a link 15 minutes before kick-off and not before — a stream page that is not streaming yet is worse than no button.
